_source: ledger 0082 vegetation pass: one tree per crown the USGS 3DEP 2017-05-03 lidar measures (Oakland 2016 project, pass 2's 71 EPT nodes), checked against NAIP 2022-08-16; h_m = the crown's measured top over the lidar ground, crown_m = the diameter of its measured area (source/vegetation/scripts/veg_crowns.py, veg_plan.py). Points are [lon, lat, zone, h_m, crown_m]. Milford 0.1.5 (veg_crown_fix.py): the split and merged crowns re-segmented; the 6th element is the tree's KEY (tools/make_treefx.py hashes its model and angle by it); crown_fix.json lists every case
